   • CVR: 1.1% → 1.11% (+1%, ~flat)
   • AOV: 1,250 → 1,268 EGP (+1%, ~flat)

   *Read:* *CPC* fell -14%, the biggest of the three.
     Worth about *34,547 EGP of spend*.
     That drove ROAS +20%.
     Revenue +62% because spend +34%.
   *Deeper:* biggest single mover was *al sayad pjs - lblb*, its CPC went 5.54 EGP→4.51 EGP on 10,341 EGP spend (~7% of the swing).
